title: Master Clock
style: Electronic pop with glitchy syncopated drums, a steady four-on-the-floor pulse, and world-scale plucks trading across the stereo field; verse rides sparse bass clicks and clipped synth stabs, pre-chorus tightens with rising arps and filtered vocal layers, chorus opens into stacked hook doubles and call-and-response chants. Close-mic lead vocal with hard doubles on key phrases, panned ad-libs, reverse swells into drops, chime accents between lines, bright punchy mix with wide imaging and clean low end., world, distinct
